Mean Green came in with a 11% above average attack and a league-average defense (7-3, 41.8 scored and 31.3 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 186 and 186 games of evidence. Projected to score 34.2, they scored 24 (−10.2 points, 30% under); projected to allow 21.7, they allowed 28 (+6.3 points, 29% over).

Green Wave came in with a 17% below average attack and a 15% leakier than average defense (5-5, 21 scored and 28 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 187 and 185 games of evidence. Projected to score 21.7, they scored 28 (+6.3 points, 29% over); projected to allow 34.2, they allowed 24 (−10.2 points, 30% under).

The bigger miss was Mean Green's scoring (-10.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 52 against 55.9 projected (-3.9), about the 40th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Green Wave by 4 against Mean Green by 12.5 projected, about the 86th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Green Wave ×1.02, Mean Green ×1.00. It favored Green Wave, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
TULN ML (+235) at +235: the algo gave it 28% vs 29% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+2.4u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 29%). UNT ML (-290) at -290: the algo gave it 72% vs 71% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 71%). TULN +7.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-1.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNT -7.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 56.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 56.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 49% of bets on Mean Green, 64% of the money — Green Wave covered; total: 38% of bets on the over, 44% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 93% of bets on Mean Green, 90% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Green Wave, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.875 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +15.3 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 144 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Mean Green attack ×0.965, defense ×1.040 (3 games); Green Wave attack ×0.960, defense ×1.029 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 16.5 points), no bet.
